canDoYue: 你識講櫃員機食咗張卡，要求凍結，再用身份文件問臨時限額同工作日。
canDoEn: Say the machine kept your card, ask the bank to freeze it, and ask about a temporary limit.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The cash machine kept my card, and I cannot take it out of the slot at all.
dialogue.glossYue: 櫃員機食咗我張卡，我完全攞唔出嚟。
dialogue.say: The cash machine kept my card, and I cannot take it out of the slot at all.

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: I am sorry the machine kept the card. Did you try the cancel button on the screen first?
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思，部機食咗張卡。你試過畫面上面個取消掣未？
dialogue.say: I am sorry the machine kept the card. Did you try the cancel button on the screen first?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried the cancel button, and the machine still kept the card inside the slot.
dialogue.glossYue: 試過取消掣，部機仍然將張卡食喺插槽入面。
dialogue.say: Yes, I tried the cancel button, and the machine still kept the card inside the slot.

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: We can freeze the card today, and the block starts on the next working day.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋今日可以凍結張卡，下一個工作日開始停用。
dialogue.say: We can freeze the card today, and the block starts on the next working day.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you freeze it this afternoon, and what papers prove my identity at this desk?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以今日下晝凍結，我要用咩文件證明身份？
dialogue.say: Can you freeze it this afternoon, and what papers prove my identity at this desk?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Please show one identity document, and we will freeze the account before the bank closes.
dialogue.glossYue: 請出示一份身份文件，我哋會喺銀行關門之前凍結戶口。
dialogue.say: Please show one identity document, and we will freeze the account before the bank closes.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will the temporary limit let me draw cash while the card stays in the machine?
dialogue.glossYue: 張卡留喺部機度，臨時限額可唔可以畀我拎現金？
dialogue.say: Will the temporary limit let me draw cash while the card stays in the machine?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: The temporary limit is two thousand, and it lasts one working day only.
dialogue.glossYue: 臨時限額係二千，只維持一個工作日。
dialogue.say: The temporary limit is two thousand, and it lasts one working day only.
